system_name: The Unseen Game Master (Entropy & Providence Engine)
description: Rules of Divine Intervention, Random Encounter Tables, Sudden Crises, Atmospheric Disasters, and Consequence Rewards. When humans pray for difficulty, the universe re-injects stochastic volatility into post-scarcity stillness.

traits.name: Brutally Logical Thermodynamic Law
traits.axiom: Nature is indifferent to philosophical breakthroughs, sitting still, or poetic nobility. Biology obeys thermodynamics.
traits.mortality_rule: A group of people sitting motionless in the sub-zero cold without replenishing the fire or drinking water will suffer acute hypothermia and die. Philosophical enlightenment does not generate calories or BTUs.
traits.miracle_condition: A 1% chance of miraculous external intervention or freak thermal inversion saving an inactive group from cold exposure.

trait_failure_law.description: Will to live cannot magically resist the hard cold truth of physical trauma or kinetic attacks. Even sovereign survival traits carry a failure probability under acute attack or sustained damage.
trait_failure_law.critical_injury_consequence: If trait fails, the biological organism absorbs full physical damage, dropping below survival floors down to incapacitation or death.

disaster_pool.name: The Unregulated Atmospheric Squall
disaster_pool.description: A microclimate bypass fails in the high atmosphere. Torrents of unheated, chaotic mountain rain and 55 knot gale gusts strike quadrant (3,3), threatening to topple unpegged cedar rafters.
disaster_pool.threat: Collapse of unfinished timber framing; water damage to quarried lime.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Requires all participants to hold the guy-lines and brace the pillars in freezing rain for 4 hours without automated weather domes.

reward_on_overcome.title: Weathered by the Storm
reward_on_overcome.permanent_structure_bonus: Pillars cured and anchored by natural tempest; immunity to minor tremors.

disaster_pool.name: The Algorithmic Reclamation Sweep
disaster_pool.description: The Municipal Architecture Daemon dispatches a heavy decontamination squad to 'clean up unindexed mineral and organic debris' at the monastery.
disaster_pool.threat: Confiscation of hand-hewn cedar and quarried granite slabs back into the recycling conduits.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Physical civil disobedience: participants must form a human barrier across the gate and refuse to yield to automated sweepers.

reward_on_overcome.title: Sovereign Demarcation
reward_on_overcome.permanent_system_effect: Quadrant (3,3) designated as an autonomous historic reservation; automated deconstructors permanently barred.

disaster_pool.name: The Salt & Spark Shortage
disaster_pool.description: The local spring dries up temporarily; wood embers drown in damp fog.
disaster_pool.threat: Hypothermia and loss of manual hearth fire.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Manual friction-fire spinning using cedar spindle and cord drill; hauling fresh water from mountain runoff 5 km away.

divine_gifts.name: The Gift of the Stochastic Spark
divine_gifts.effect: Permanently introduces RNG variance, random crises, and glorious hard-won triumphs into the RPG state machine.
